svg.title: Current Firmable architecture: grouped ontology onboarding and the established company-profile pipeline
svg.desc: Six lanes show source evidence, inspection and optional joins, a bounded group-agent revision loop, candidate evaluation and human review, established identity resolution, and company profiles. The experimental candidate path stops at a production boundary. Automatic promotion is not implemented. Existing approved configurations feed the core resolution pipeline separately. Saved source, mapping and ontology identities preserve provenance.
svg.text: CODE
AGENT
AGENT + CODE
HUMAN
SAVED
Acquire source evidence
SHARED INPUTS / Files and evidence, before any semantic inference
Existing approved sources retain their established mapping configs; new-source experiments follow the path below.
Understand the incoming dataset
EXPERIMENT / Inspector, optional join planner and shared readers
Join checks: missing keys, duplicate keys and row multiplication. Unsafe matches are refused with reasons.
Implemented joins: one-to-one / many-to-one star joins. Other shapes require an extension.
Reason and revise one column group
EXPERIMENT / Model decisions become executable rules through a shared compiler
Targeted repair: mapping / ontology / both
Revision returns to mapping, ontology, or both. Repeated proposals and token budgets can stop a group.
Up to 3 group attempts per pass; recovery reuses accepted work. Missing required context is counted as abstention.
Reconcile, evaluate and request review
EXPERIMENT / A technically valid candidate is still not a human-approved company fact
Review memory compares contract fingerprints: unchanged approvals may be reused; changed contracts reopen.
The recorded review-memory evaluation uses synthetic decisions. Human precision and review time remain unmeasured.
Resolve businesses with the established engine
EXISTING CORE / Approved source configs; deterministic extraction and identity resolution
Refusal branch: 1,245 unlinked records keep reasons. Audit labels do not automatically correct cluster membership.
Build profiles with traceable claims
EXISTING CORE / Deterministic profile assembly; no additional model calls
Experimental profile previews are separate: matching a source ABN is a review lead, not an approved merge.
Remaining core limitations include incomplete nested-field confidence and untested financial-source corruption.
PRODUCTION BOUNDARY — NO AUTOMATIC PROMOTION
Experimental candidates remain separate. Human contract approval does not implement identity integration or release.
SHARED EVIDENCE / REPLAY / GOVERNANCE
Snapshot + row ID → ontology version + mapping digest → observation + relationship → link decision → profile claim
